items.excerpt: New York State Police arrested 42-year-old Jerry Pollard of Canajoharie earlier this week on child sex crime charges.

items.headline: Arrest made in Johnstown burglary investigation
items.excerpt: Johnstown Police reported on Thursday that an arrest was made at the end of October in connection to a burglary investigation.

items.headline: North Country woman accused of punching, scratching victim in road rage incident
items.excerpt: An Essex County woman was charged with assault after a road rage incident in the town of North Elba.

items.headline: Peanut the squirrel's former owner has been detained by ICE and may be deported
items.excerpt: The arrest was the latest twist in the tale of Peanut, also known as P’nut, a once-orphaned squirrel whose fun antics made him a social media star.

items.headline: Yerdon gets 21 years in prison for having child sex abuse images
items.excerpt: James Yerdon, a man accused of sexually abusing children in Albany County and admitted to receiving and possessing child sex abuse images has been sentenced in federal court. According to the U.S. Attorney's Office, Yerdon was sentenced to 21 years and 10 months in prison.

items.headline: Comedian and actor Anthony Clark, of 'Yes, Dear' and 'Boston Common,' dies at 62
items.excerpt: Friend and 'Yes, Dear' co-star Mike O'Malley announced Clark's passing on social media.

items.headline: Search underway for man reported missing in Dutchess County
items.excerpt: Shane Subburamu, 31, was first reported missing on November 7.

items.headline: Scotia native, powerlifter Erin Michael defends world title in wake of tragedy
items.excerpt: Last Tuesday — the day Michael was set to travel to Houston for the 2026 IDFPA World Championships — Michael's mother, Bonnie Michael, died suddenly from leukemia, complicated by pneumonia.
